kind: portable actual-C CSTACK opt-in host-contract summary
product_admission: Pending exact formal rebuild and firmware gates; host contract alone is insufficient

option.name: M5_WASM_CSTACK_TRACE
option.parse: Exact literal1, cached once per source translation unit per host thread; all other values disabled.

actual_execution.location: Temporary directory containing only the three proposed files; no checkout cache, ignored artifacts or network dependency.
actual_execution.reproduction: Copy the three listed files preserving relative paths; run python3 -m unittest discover -s platform/tests -p test_cstack_diagnostics_opt_in_patch.py -v

differential_oracle.extraction: Full-function patch context reconstructs both exact preimage and postimage with SHA verification; forward/reverse patch checks precede real C extraction and host execution.
differential_oracle.real_controller_functions: MMU invalidation/MMU-table write and coroutine switch implementations are extracted, not reimplemented as a separate optimized algorithm.
differential_oracle.behavior_compared: Block read and IOMMU effects, invalid/unchanged writes and flash/PSRAM/no-backend boundaries, coroutine current/action and fiber-call observations remain equal to the original implementation.
differential_oracle.fixtures: Block I/O, IOMMU, fiber, stack/heap/thread getters and getenv are instrumented host fixtures. This does not execute real Asyncify fibers or a QEMU guest.

controls.trace_on: Literal1 preserves original trace phases, IDs, skipped/invalid ID gaps,256-line per-category budgets and original getter counts in both threads. Trace pointer identity is normalized for host process ASLR only.
controls.trace_off: All six disabled modes preserve controller/fiber observations and produce zero trace, zero ID/counter advancement and zero stack/heap/base/end/thread-ID output preparation. The one-time option lookup remains.
controls.late_option_change: Each per-file/thread cache retains its initial decision after the fixture changes its supplied value.
controls.negative_control_execution: Portable test compiles the four mutations of the actual postimage source and rejects missing zero-preparation or behavior equality.

earlier_attempt.status: HOST FIXTURE COMPILER WARNING FAILURE PRESERVED
earlier_attempt.cause: The unchanged legacy controller loop triggered signed-versus-size_t warning under fixture-Werror. The fixture compiler policy was aligned with existing GPIO contracts using-Wno-sign-compare; compiler diagnostics were exposed.

related_original_host_result.scope: Earlier ignored host-C oracle result; final portable three-file test above is the ordinary-checkout proof.

limits: Host fixtures do not prove actual SDK fiber, nested Asyncify, SjLj, browser memory or firmware timing correctness.
No Factory stability, watchdog, Double-exception, frame-rate or startup improvement is granted by these tests.
The initial preparation manifest remains a historical PREPARED record; the later portable execution record provides the actual3-method result.
No external publication or source-lock admission is authorized by this summary.
redaction: No host absolute paths, credentials, private endpoints, firmware bytes, session IDs or raw pointer values.
